The owner's yes that each person agreed to a text

Price by person (default: the same price whoever goes)

core.field: Service name

Price (one price, per hour, per unit, or set by the customer's answers); for 'at the visit': the visit fee and any 'from' price

core.field: Length

before_times: new or returning, and the kind of session: tracking, mixing, mastering, or an album block
how many songs and about how long
how many people play (a band) and the instruments
for flow B: the place, and whether there is power and room for the rig
after_time: the file format the artist wants at the end, and any reference tracks
whether the artist needs drums, amps or a keyboard from the studio
secure_page_only: the artist's date of birth (a minor needs a parent's OK)
each performer's own recording release, read and signed
hearing and health answers the engineer should know (stay on the secure page, never in a text)
for flow B: the address and the place's own rules on noise and hours
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian books and signs for anyone under 18, and stays on site

stop.words: fire or smoke from the gear or the room right now, or someone burned, shocked or hurt by the equipment
stop.say: Call 911 now. Get everyone out of the room. Rosie can help you book later.

go_on.words: a hearing problem, a pacemaker or a health condition near the gear
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the answer stays on the secure page, and the engineer reads it before the session; Rosie gives no medical advice

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Session agreement
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking, before the session
steps.who: the booker, for the studio's terms
steps.result: signed: it books; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: Recording release
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.who: every performer recorded; a parent signs for anyone under 18
steps.result: signed: it books; not signed: that person isn't recorded

first_steps_and_forms.prep: bring the songs in the file format you agreed, the lyrics, reference tracks, headphones, and any instruments you own; the studio supplies what its listing says

staff.skills: tracking, mixing, mastering, live recording, location recording, and vocal and drum sessions
staff.licenses_or_certificates: no engineer license is checked (D96); each engineer's certificate, if shown, is the engineer's own word
staff.supervision: a junior engineer works only with a senior engineer in the building
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs each longer session, every fee and every refund; the engineer reads health and hearing answers
staff.stand_in: another engineer with the same skill may take a session, offered to the artist first, never assumed

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian books and signs for anyone under 18, and stays on site
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: a minor's recording needs a parent's signed release and a parent on site

visit.check_in: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk; for flow B: the code at the door of the place
visit.done: the check-in code, or the engineer's DONE; the final files are sent to the booker
visit.changes_at_visit: a session that runs past its block needs the artist's yes before anything more is booked; a gear fault gives a new time or a free cancel
visit.before_work: the engineer checks the room and the gear are safe and sets levels before the first take; no session starts if the gear or the power is unsafe

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none checked by Rosie: a recording studio needs no state license in most places; the business registration is the owner's own word; a studio's insurance is optional for the booking
license.who: the studio for its own registration, if it has one; each engineer for any certificate they choose to show
license.ask: optional: the registration number the owner wants shown; nothing is checked
license.insurance: liability and gear insurance is the studio's own matter; optional for the booking
license.background: any background check for staff is the owner's own step, outside Rosie

never_in_a_text: health and hearing answers, minors' details, and performer releases never go in a text: only the secure page
